description: Letter fragment in Hebrew and Judaeo-Arabic. Late. Very faded. The beginnings of several lines of the main text are preserved and several lines of the perpendicular marginal text. Mentions something that "belongs only to God" (אלא מתאע אללה).
description_he: מכתב בעברית, יהודית-ערבית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
